speaker: Doctor
text: Please describe your specific symptoms regarding the gait and limb ataxia you mentioned, and tell me about your significant medical history. REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Vitamin_B12, TSH, Syphilis_Serology.

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Multiple sclerosis and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple Sclerosis. Given your history of Crohn's disease treated with natalizumab, the development of gait and limb ataxia is highly characteristic of relapsing-remitting Multiple Sclerosis, as natalizumab is an immunomodulator used for MS. The previous physician's assessment of a "typical" presentation further supports this clinical picture.
